text:
Yara Haddad  
Berlin, Germany | yarahaddad@example.com | +49 123 456 7890  

A junior game developer specializing in adtech integration, with a focus on bridging interactive entertainment and real-time advertising systems. Over the past two years, I’ve contributed to scalable ad networks and mobile game mechanics, collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize user engagement while maintaining technical integrity. My work balances creativity with precision, ensuring seamless experiences for both players and advertisers.  

Technical Skills  
Proficient in C#/.NET for Unity-based ad integration systems, including real-time bidding logic and dynamic ad placement. Experienced with REST API design for connecting ad servers to game backends. Familiar with Python for scripting automation in QA workflows. Basic understanding of game physics for collision detection in ad placement simulations. Limited exposure to game networking for synchronized ad triggers across multiplayer environments. Unity as a primary tool for prototyping ad-driven game mechanics. Unreal Engine used in a single project for visualizing ad placement scenarios.  

Professional Experience  
At AdvertisePlay Technologies, I collaborated on real-time ad integration systems using Unity, ensuring seamless ad insertion without disrupting gameplay flow. Responsibilities included debugging ad load times, implementing fallback mechanisms for failed ad requests, and documenting API endpoints for backend teams. This work supported a 15% improvement in ad impression rates across three titles.  

As a Game Development Intern at PixelPulse Studios, I assisted in UI/UX prototyping for ad-driven mobile games, focusing on user retention metrics. This involved iterating on ad placement hotspots and testing monetization strategies that balanced revenue with player satisfaction.  

Freelance QA work with GameTest Collective involved evaluating ad-supported game mechanics, identifying bugs in ad lifecycle management, and providing feedback to refine monetization models.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Game Development, Newport University, 2022. Thesis: "Monetization Strategies in Mobile Casual Games: A Case Study of Ad Integration."  

Projects  
1. **Real-Time Ad Integration System**: Developed a Unity-based framework for dynamic ad insertion, reducing latency by 20% through optimized asset loading.  
2. **Ad Network Simulator**: Created a Python tool to mock ad server responses, enabling QA teams to test edge cases without live data.  
3. **Multiplayer Ad Synchronization**: Experimented with networking code to align ad triggers across player sessions, addressing latency issues in co-op gameplay.  

Languages  
English (fluent), French (conversational)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized at AdvertisePlay for contributing to a high-performing ad network module that increased CTR by 12% in Q3 2023. Freelance QA award for thoroughness in identifying ad-related bugs during a major game launch.
